maddeler.e:
استشففت (form X)
# اِسْتَشْفَفْتُ (istašfaftu) /is.taʃ.faf.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَشَفَّ (istašaffa)
# اِسْتَشْفَفْتَ (istašfafta) /is.taʃ.faf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَشَفَّ (istašaffa)
# اِسْتَشْفَفْتِ (istašfafti) /is.taʃ.faf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَشَفَّ (istašaffa)
# اُسْتُشْفِفْتُ (ustušfiftu) /us.tuʃ.
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
